title.zh: 低于本厂可铸最小壁厚

reason.zh: 二厂离心铸造最小壁厚 0.9 mm，来料 {min_wall_thickness_mm} mm 无法充满。
reason.en: Centrifugal casting needs 0.9 mm; {min_wall_thickness_mm} mm will not fill.

text.zh: 加厚到 0.9 mm 以上，或转一厂真空铸造。
text.en: Thicken to 0.9 mm or route to the vacuum caster at WS-JW-A.

reason.zh: 二厂最大铸件尺寸 30 mm，来料 {max_dimension_mm} mm 需要转厂。
reason.en: The envelope is 30 mm; {max_dimension_mm} mm needs another workshop.

text.zh: 缩到 30 mm 以内，或转一厂。
text.en: Reduce below 30 mm, or move to WS-JW-A.

reason.zh: 二厂只排产 18k 金与 925 银，来料 {alloy} 不在排产范围。
reason.en: This workshop only schedules 18k gold and 925 silver; {alloy} is out of scope.

text.zh: 改用 18k 金或 925 银，或转一厂。
text.en: Switch to 18k gold or 925 silver, or use WS-JW-A.

title.zh: 戒圈小于本厂最小手寸

reason.zh: 二厂撑圈模具覆盖 48-58 mm，来料 {ring_size_mm} mm 无对应模具。
reason.en: Mandrels cover 48-58 mm; {ring_size_mm} mm has no matching tool.

text.zh: 调整到 50 mm 以上，或转一厂。
text.en: Adjust to at least 50 mm, or use WS-JW-A.

title.zh: 戒圈大于本厂最大手寸

reason.zh: 二厂撑圈模具上限 58 mm，来料 {ring_size_mm} mm 超限。
reason.en: Mandrels stop at 58 mm; {ring_size_mm} mm exceeds the tooling.

text.zh: 缩到 56 mm 以内，或转一厂。
text.en: Reduce below 56 mm, or use WS-JW-A.

reason.zh: 二厂珐琅炉上限 750 摄氏度，来料烧成温度 {enamel_firing_c} 摄氏度超限。
reason.en: The furnace tops out at 750 C; the submitted firing temperature is {enamel_firing_c} C.

text.zh: 改用 750 摄氏度以下低温珐琅，或转一厂。
text.en: Use an enamel below 750 C, or use WS-JW-A.

qc_checkpoints.method: digital caliper, three points per axis
qc_checkpoints.pass_criteria: all dimensions within 0.05 mm, minimum wall not below the assessed value

qc_checkpoints.method: manual pull test plus loupe inspection at 10x
qc_checkpoints.pass_criteria: no stone movement, no prong gap above 0.02 mm

qc_checkpoints.method: visual inspection under daylight lamp, hallmark verification
qc_checkpoints.pass_criteria: no polishing compound residue, hallmark and purity mark legible
